summary: Expose read-only miner work diagnostics and pass node-kit anchor gap to geth
details: Add miner_getUSDBWorkStatus in the trusted local miner namespace. Return bounded in-memory last-attempt and submitted-work snapshots without external queries or raw upstream errors.

Bind each historical build to the submitted work seal hash and parent; invalidate current-work status when mining stops or the canonical parent changes. Distinguish a failed newer build from previous submitted work.
Propagate USDB_MINER_ANCHOR_GAP to explicit geth arguments for all roles; default to 2 and preserve zero. Network identity and validator rules are unchanged.
operator_actions: Use usdb-node mining configure --anchor-gap N only for advanced local policy changes, then usdb-node up and mining status. Ordinary setup keeps the recommended gap.
Upgrade the node kit and chain image together. Independent multi-node gap measurements remain a separate qualification stage.
